name: Spellbook
summary: AI assistant for transactional lawyers, inside Word.
description: Spellbook reviews and drafts contracts directly in Microsoft Word: it flags risks, suggests clauses and compares against market standards. It's aimed at transactional lawyers.

howToUse.title: Open Spellbook
howToUse.description: Open Spellbook, which works in Microsoft Word for transactional lawyers, and start the seven-day trial that is offered.

howToUse.title: Review the contract
howToUse.description: In the Word add-in, Spellbook redlines contracts and flags the risks it finds, then applies your playbooks.

howToUse.title: Draft and compare
howToUse.description: Ask Spellbook so it drafts clauses from scratch or from saved libraries. It compares those terms against market standards and answers your questions. Associate runs the multi-document workflows.

howToUse.title: Ask about access
howToUse.description: Pricing stays custom. Academic institutions can request free access, and Spellbook is SOC 2 Type II compliant according to what the site reports.

summary_fr: Assistant IA pour avocats d'affaires, intégré à Word.
description_fr: Spellbook relit et rédige les contrats directement dans Microsoft Word : il repère les risques, propose des clauses et compare avec les standards du marché. Il s'adresse aux avocats transactionnels.
